 Wareable Top Pick Awards at CES 2027: Entries are now open
 by 
 The Wareable Team 
 ◆ 
 1 hour ago 
 ◆ 
 2 min read
 Brands presenting innovative wearable tech devices at CES 2027, we invite you to submit for Wareable’s Top Pick Awards
 Wareable team is returning to CES Las Vegas 2027, where another wave of recent wearable tech is set to take over the show floor.
 If your company is unveiling something new in wearables, health tech, smart accessories, or XR at the show, submissions are now open for you to nominate it for Top Pick Awards consideration.
 We’re looking for launches that feel well executed and worth our readers’ attention.
 How to enter
 To submit your product for the CES 2027 Top Pick Award, click the link below and follow the instructions.
 CLICK HERE TO SUBMIT PRODUCTS FOR TOP PICK AWARD CONSIDERATION 
 Each submission will be reviewed independently by our team based on the information provided, and only the most impressive products will receive Top Pick recognition.
 If your product wins or receives an honorable mention, it will be featured in our winners’ announcement on our website, and you’ll be able to license the official Wareable Top Pic Awards badge.
 Award categories
 The Top Pick Awards cover a range of categories in wearable and health tech. If your innovation fits one of the categories below, you can put it forward for consideration:
 Smartwatches & Fitness Trackers
 Smart Rings & Jewelry
 Smart Glasses & XR
 Audio/Hearables
 Wellness & Therapy
 Beauty Tech
 Sports & Smart Apparel
 Family, Kids & Pets
 Emerging Tech
 Submission requirements
 To be considered for the Top Pick Award, your nomination form must be completed and submitted by 27 December 2026, 23:59 CET.
 Once you’ve submitted your entry, it will be reviewed by Wareable’s team on the basis of the product description, specification, images, videos, demos and any other supporting materials you provide. This will give us a real insight into what makes your innovation worthy of consideration.
 Just keep in mind that your product must be new or materially updated since CES 2026. It must also be scheduled to appear on the CES 2027 show floor. Concepts and prototypes with no planned launch aren’t eligible.
 For full details about eligibility and the submission process, please read our Wareable Top Pick Awards Terms & Conditions .
 CLICK HERE TO SUBMIT PRODUCTS FOR TOP PICK AWARD CONSIDERATION 
 Previous winners
 We’ve followed CES for years, and each show brings a fresh wave of wearable and health tech launches worth watching.
 Last year was no exception. If you want to see which products stood out to us at CES 2026, check out our Best in Show 2026 article.
